# sherpa-calendar-cell

One day, month or year in a calendar's grid. Figma "Calendar Cell" (276:16589).

|  |  |

| Built on | the native `<button>`, which gives click, keyboard, focus, disabled |

## When to use it

One day, month or year in a calendar's grid; `sherpa-calendar` draws its cells and sets each `data-state` itself. To let a reader pick a date or a range, use `sherpa-calendar`.

## Example

```html
<div role="grid" aria-label="August 2026"><div role="row"><sherpa-calendar-cell role="gridcell" data-label="15" data-value="2026-08-15"></sherpa-calendar-cell></div></div>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-label` | text |  | when absent, so a cell with no calendar around it still reports something. |
| `data-outside` | boolean |  | this day belongs to the neighbouring month |
| `data-state` | `default` `today` `selected` `range-start` `range-end` `range-mid` |  | default (omitted) \| today \| selected \| range-start \| range-end \| range-mid |
| `data-value` | text |  | the ISO date this cell STANDS FOR (2026-09-18), which is what cell-click carries. The label is a number in the month's own terms and cannot say which month; this can. Falls back to |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native — outside data-min / data-max |
